body: These could be removed now I think.
What do you mean? They're used below, do you envision a way to do the version comparisons without those?

Could be unified to:
```
update_hint = vformat("Disable Update Checks,Auto (%s),Check Newest Preview,Check Newest Stable,Check Newest Patch", GODOT_VERSION_STATUS == "stable" ? "Stable" : "Preview");
```
I mean GODOT_VERSION_MAJOR etc. can be used directly, there is no reason to additionally assign them to variables.
